task.title: Setting the role of a team within an organization by using the API
task.shortdesc: To view repository permissions for a team or set a team’s role in an Red Hat Quay organization, you can use the organization team API endpoints with an OAuth access token.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: Enter the following GET /api/v1/organization/{orgname}/team/{teamname}/permissions command to return a list of repository permissions for the organization’s team. Note that your team must have been added to a repository for this command to return information.
